name: The Lost Hunter
description:
About This Game

BULLET - TIME EFFECT:

Aim, pull the trigger and follow the bullet's journey moment by moment!

Thanks to the bullet tracking effect in our game, you will be able to track the power and impact of each shot in detail. Take your hunting experience to the next level by tracking every bullet as it reaches the target, whether it's in vast woodlands or open fields.

This feature makes every moment more strategic and exciting. Now it's all up to your sniping skills to hit the target!

CRAFT SYSTEM:

Not only will you hunt the prey, but you'll also process it into valuable resources!

Not only will you get meat from the animals you hunt, but you'll also be able to use the craft system to collect leather and other materials. You can set up camp and build a fire to cook the meat you've gathered, and test your survival skills by preparing your own food.

But the hunt is only the beginning! With the materials you gather, you can craft new equipment, upgrade your weapons or strengthen your camp. You can also chop wood for valuable resources to trade and craft new items with craft mechanics.

Nature offers everything you need to survive - it's just a matter of knowing how to use it!

EAGLE TRACKING SYSTEM:

Your faithful friend, your talismanic eagle, will be your greatest helper during your hunting adventure!

This mysterious and powerful eagle will scour the skies to track prey and guide you. When you lose your way or danger approaches, he will always be by your side.

His keen eyes will make spotting prey and strategizing much easier. This unique bond with your eagle will unite your hunting not only with skill, but also with intuition and the power of nature.

ENERGY DRINK - THE MECHANICS OF SLEEP:

Using the right supplements is just as important as resting to survive!

At certain times, your character can replenish their energy by sleeping or consuming energy drinks. But you have to be careful; nature becomes more dangerous when night falls. Sleeping and consuming energy drinks require you to make strategic decisions about how to spend the night.

If you choose to go without sleep, energy drinks can keep you going, but this will strain your immunity in the long run. If you get sick or injured, antibiotics will be one of the most important resources to keep you alive.

SHOOTING RANGE:

Thanks to the shooting range system exclusive to our game, you can test and improve your shooting skills. Equipped with different distances and targets, it's the ideal environment to hone your aiming skills. Master the range with sharp reflexes and the right strategies and get ready for the real hunting adventure!

TRADE MECHANICS:

You can earn income from hunting by selling resources such as meat, skins and bones to traders who open at certain times. Trading is one of the most important ways to increase your chances of survival. With the money you earn, you can buy the equipment that the trader offers and make the hunting and survival process more efficient. However, traders will not always be open, so you need to time your trades well and use your resources strategically.
short_desc: The Lost Hunter is a realistic hunting and survival simulation. Hunt in dynamic weather conditions, collect resources and upgrade your equipment. Your eagle will guide you on the trail. Dangers increase at night; are you ready to survive with your strategy and skills?
